cards.text:
风暴飞鹰
阵营规则
伞兵入侵
在战斗开始前部署风暴飞鹰杀戮小队时，杀戮
小队中三分之一的特工必须按照常规进行部署。
在那之后每三分之一的特工可以被部署至高处：
将这些特工放在一边，而不是部署至杀戮区中。
在将三分之一的特工部署至高处时，这些特工都
必须按照这个方式部署（您不能只将其中的个别
特工部署至高处)，随后将一枚空降标识放置在
完全位于己方降落区内的位置。
在第一和第二转折点中，作为一个战略计划，您
可以将空降标识移动最多 4"，仅计算移动的水平
距离。在近距离战斗中，您可以让标识移动穿过
墙壁并以这个方式测量距离。
在交战阶段中，被部署至高处的己方风暴飞鹰特
工将照常被激活。在将这些特工激活时，您可以选
择让其进入待机或者着陆。如果选择让特工着陆，
那么按照以下规定将其部署在杀戮区中一个可以容
纳该特工的位置（特工不再被部署至高处)：
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
TEMPESTUS AQUILON
FACTION RULE
DROP INSERTION
When setting up a TEMPESTUS AQUILON kill
team before the battle, the first third of your
kill team must be set up as normal. Each third
thereafter can be set up above: place them to
one side instead of in the killzone. For each third
that’s set up above, you must set up the whole
third in this way (not some of them), then place
one of your Drop markers wholly within your
drop zone.
As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in the first and second
turning point, you can move your Drop markers
up to 4" horizontally. In a killzone that uses the
close quarters rules (e.g. Killzone: Tomb World),
this can be measured and moved through
Wall terrain.
In the Firefight phase, friendly TEMPESTUS
AQUILON operatives set up above are activated
as normal. When you do, you can either expend
or land that operative. If it lands, set it up in the
killzone in a location it can be placed as follows
(it’s no longer set up above):
RULE CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
• 位于己方空降标识的 3" 内，仅测量水平距
离，或者完全位于己方降落区内。
• 位于敌方特工的控制范围外（除非您部署的是
先行者特工，该特工可以被部署至敌方特工的
控制范围内)。
• 特工底座的任何部分都不能位于制高点地形的
下方。
• 您将决定特工拥有的命令。
通过这个方式部署的特工将视作为执行了转移行
动（消耗对应数量的 AP)，随后照常进行特工的
激活。直到下一次激活结束或者转折点结束前
（以先到的条件为准)，该特工视为被遮挡。
在第一转折点结束时，只有半数以下的特工能被
允许部署至高处。也就是说，在第一转折点结束
时，您必须将杀戮小队中至少一半以上数量的特
工部署至杀戮区。
当您在第二和第三转折点就绪特工时，分别移除
一枚空降标识。这意味着在第二转折点结束时还
依旧部署至高处的特工将被残废。
cards.text_en:
• Within 3" horizontally of one of your Drop
markers, or wholly within your drop zone.
• Not within control range of enemy operatives
(unless you’re setting up a PRECURSOR
operative, which can be set up within control
range of an enemy operative).
• With no part of its base underneath
Vantage terrain.
• With an order of your choice.
The operative is treated as performing the
Reposition action (spend the AP accordingly),
then continue its activation as normal. It’s
obscured until the end of the next activation
or the end of the turning point (whichever
comes first).
Less than half of your operatives can be set up
above by the end of the first turning point. In
other words, by the end of the first turning point,
more than half of your operatives must have been
set up in the killzone during the battle.
When readying your operatives during the second
and third turning points, remove one of your
Drop markers. This means operatives still set up
above are incapacitated at the end of the second
turning point.

cards.text:
风暴飞鹰
阵营规则
重力伞
重力伞所生成的反重力力场可以让装备者快
速且稳定地安全着陆，无论落差。
己方风暴飞鹰特工在进行跳落时忽略所有垂直
距离。
cards.text_en:
TEMPESTUS AQUILON
FACTION RULE
GRAV‑CHUTE
Grav‑chutes employ gravitic repulsion fields to allow
their wearers to drop at a swift but measured pace and
land safely, no matter from what height they fall.
Whenever a friendly TEMPESTUS AQUILON
operative is dropping, ignore the vertical distance.

风暴飞鹰擅长快速空降至战斗区域并在敌人还
未察觉时发起进攻。
计算还没有被残废的己方风暴飞鹰特工的数
量，随后将结果减半（向上取整）并计算出 x。
在激活己方风暴飞鹰特工时，如果该特工是转
折点中最初 x 个被激活的己方风暴飞鹰特工，
那么直到特工的激活结束前，该特工的武器拥
有“平衡”武器规则。例如，如果存在五名没
有被残废的己方特工，那么在转折点中最初三
个被激活的特工将获得本计谋的增益效果。
cards.text_en:
TEMPESTUS AQUILON
STRATEGY PLOY
SUDDEN OFFENSIVE
Tempestus Aquilons are skilled at dropping swiftly into
combat and catching their enemies unawares.
Count the number of friendly TEMPESTUS
AQUILON operatives that aren’t incapacitated,
then halve the result (rounding up) to give
you x. Until the end of their activation, friendly
TEMPESTUS AQUILON operatives’ weapons
have the Balanced weapon rule if they are the
first friendly operatives activated this turning
point equal to x. For example, if you have five
operatives, the first three friendly operatives
activated will benefit.

cards.text:
风暴飞鹰
战略计谋
保持势头
一旦开始了突袭，风暴飞鹰就会持续施压，让
敌人猝不及防。
在一名己方风暴飞鹰特工对就绪的敌方特工
进行射击或者近战时，该特工的武器拥有“严
重”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
TEMPESTUS AQUILON
STRATEGY PLOY
MAINTAIN MOMENTUM
Once the assault begins, the Aquilons sustain the
pressure, keeping their enemies reeling and off balance.
Whenever a friendly TEMPESTUS AQUILON
operative is shooting against or fighting against a
ready enemy operative, that friendly operative’s
weapons have the Severe weapon rule.

cards.text:
风暴飞鹰
战略计谋
空中侦查
空中飞行的伺服颅骨和侦查机能够为风暴飞鹰
提供实时更新的战术资料。
选择一名敌方特工。直到转折点结束前，那名
特工以及其 3" 内的所有其他敌方特工获得一枚
己方的侦测指示物。在一名敌方特工拥有侦测
指示物时：
• 如果该特工对一名己方风暴飞鹰特工进行射
击，那么您可以重掷一枚防御骰。
• 如果该特工对一名己方风暴飞鹰特工进行近
战或者反击，那么您可以使用一次格挡来格
挡两次对手没有结算的成功（而不是只格挡
一次）。
cards.text_en:
TEMPESTUS AQUILON
STRATEGY PLOY
EYE ABOVE
Airborne servo‑skulls and spotter aircraft keep the
Aquilons appraised of up‑to‑the‑minute tactical data.
Select one enemy operative. That operative and
each other enemy operative within 3" of it gains
one of your Detected tokens until the end of the
turning point. Whenever an enemy operative that
has one of your Detected tokens:
• Is shooting a friendly TEMPESTUS
AQUILON operative, you can re‑roll one of
your defence dice.
• Is fighting or retaliating against a friendly
TEMPESTUS AQUILON operative, one of
your blocks can be allocated to block two
unresolved successes (instead of one).

cards.text:
风暴飞鹰
战略计谋
空降扫荡
要保证绝对的胜利，就必须确保关键战术目标
的安全。
选择一枚标识。
• 直到下一个转折点的就绪步骤前，在判断那
枚标识的控制权时，将争夺那枚标识的己方
风暴飞鹰特工的 APL 总和视为比原来高 1
点，但是需要有至少 1 名己方风暴飞鹰特工
实际在争夺那个标识。
• 位于那枚标识的 3" 内的己方风暴飞鹰特工
近战武器的攻击属性增加 1 点（最多提升至
4)。
cards.text_en:
TEMPESTUS AQUILON
STRATEGY PLOY
DROP AND SECURE
Priority tactical objectives must be secured to ensure
victory is absolute.
Select one marker.
• Until the Ready step of the next Strategy
phase, when determining control of that
marker, treat the total APL stat of friendly
TEMPESTUS AQUILON operatives that
contest it as 1 higher if at least one friendly
TEMPESTUS AQUILON operative contests
that marker. Note this isn’t a change to the APL
stat, so any changes are cumulative with this.
• Whenever a friendly TEMPESTUS
AQUILON operative is within 3" of that
marker, add 1 to the Atk stat of its melee
weapons (to a maximum of 4).

cards.text:
风暴飞鹰
交战计谋
空降区激战
风暴飞鹰被训练空降至最激烈的战斗中，在着
陆之前就会与受惊的敌人展开交火。
如果一名己方风暴飞鹰特工完全位于对手的领
地内，或是在本次激活中着陆，或者从高于杀戮
区地面至少 2" 的制高点地形上跳落，那么在其
掷出攻击骰后使用此交战计谋。如果目标位于该
特工的 6" 内，您可以对任何攻击骰进行重掷。
cards.text_en:
TEMPESTUS AQUILON
FIREFIGHT PLOY
HOT DROP
Aquilons are trained to drop into the thick of fighting,
engaging a surprised enemy as they land.
Use this firefight ploy after rolling your attack dice
for a friendly TEMPESTUS AQUILON operative
that’s wholly within your opponent’s territory, or
either landed or dropped from Vantage terrain at
least 2" higher than the killzone floor during this
activation. If the target is within 6" of it, you can
re‑roll any of your attack dice.

cards.text:
风暴飞鹰
交战计谋
调整坐标
随着战斗局势的改变与进展，依旧进行空降的
风暴飞鹰们会随之改变自己的降落位置。
在一名己方风暴飞鹰特工着陆时使用此交战计
谋。您可以将其部署在己方空降标识的 5" 内
（仅测量水平距离)，本效果的优先级高于原本
的距离要求。特工在转折点中不能执行冲刺、近
战或者射击行动。
cards.text_en:
TEMPESTUS AQUILON
FIREFIGHT PLOY
ADJUST COORDINATES
As the firefight flows and develops, so those Aquilons
still descending adjust their trajectories in response.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
TEMPESTUS AQUILON operative lands. You
can set it up within 5" horizontally of one of
your Drop markers, taking precedence over the
normal distance requirement. It cannot perform
the Dash, Shoot or Fight actions during this
turning point.

cards.text:
风暴飞鹰
交战计谋
风暴军楷模
风暴飞鹰经受的训练让他们能够专注执行自
己的任务，就算是在最为激烈的战斗中也是
如此。
在一名己方风暴飞鹰特工的激活期间使用此交
战计谋（伺服哨戒炮和任何 APL 属性大于 2 的
特工除外)。在那次激活中，该特工在执行拾取
标识、放置标识或者一个任务行动时需要消耗的
AP 降低 1 点。
cards.text_en:
TEMPESTUS AQUILON
FIREFIGHT PLOY
TEMPESTUS EXEMPLARS
The training and conditioning of the Tempestus Aquilons
allows them to stay focused on their mission, even
during the most ferocious firefights.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly
TEMPESTUS AQUILON operative’s activation
(excluding SERVO‑SENTRY and any operative
that has an APL stat higher than 2). During that
activation, that operative can perform the Pick
Up Marker, Place Marker or a mission action for
1 less AP.

cards.text:
风暴飞鹰
交战计谋
忠嗣战士
作为忠嗣学院的毕业生，这些战士不仅会毫
不迟疑地遵循一切命令，还对帝国教条拥有
极度狂热的信仰，帮助他们忽视自身的苦痛
和恐惧。
在一名己方风暴飞鹰特工（伺服哨戒炮除外）
被激活时使用此交战计谋。特工回复 2D3 点失
去的耐伤，并且在那次激活期间忽视所有对其
APL 属性的修正。
cards.text_en:
TEMPESTUS AQUILON
FIREFIGHT PLOY
PROGENA
As graduates of the Schola Progenium, these warriors
are not only conditioned to follow their orders with
unquestioning precision, but are also driven by a zealous
dedication to the Imperial Cult that helps them to shrug
off pain and fear.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
TEMPESTUS AQUILON operative (excluding
SERVO‑SENTRY) is activated. It regains up to 2D3
lost wounds, and during that activation you can
ignore any changes to its APL stat.

cards.text:
风暴飞鹰
阵营装备
风暴军匕首
每一位战士在加入风暴军时都会获得这件武
器，它们也被作为兵团的荣誉徽记使用。
己方风暴飞鹰特工（伺服哨戒炮除外）拥有以
下近战武器：
名称攻击命中伤害
风暴军匕首 3 4+ 3/4
cards.text_en:
TEMPESTUS AQUILON
FACTION EQUIPMENT
TEMPESTUS DAGGERS
Awarded to each warrior of the Militarum Tempestus
upon their induction to the ranks, these weapons double
as a symbol of regimental pride.
Friendly TEMPESTUS AQUILON operatives
(excluding SERVO‑SENTRY) have the following
melee weapon:
NAME ATK HIT DMG
Tempestus dagger 3 4+ 3/4

cards.text:
风暴飞鹰
阵营装备
战斗兴奋剂
在风暴飞鹰中，军务部批准的战斗兴奋剂的使
用情况十分普遍，因为这些战士很可能会需要
在长达数日的战斗中保持警惕。
您可以忽略任何己方风暴飞鹰特工在受创时所
受到的对移动属性的修正。
cards.text_en:
TEMPESTUS AQUILON
FACTION EQUIPMENT
COMBAT STIMMS
The use of Munitorum‑approved combat stimulants is
standard practice amongst the Tempestus Aquilons,
who may have to remain alert and fighting for days at
a time.
You can ignore any changes to the Move stat of
friendly TEMPESTUS AQUILON operatives from
being injured.

cards.text:
风暴飞鹰
阵营装备
空降占卜仪
在与敌人开始交战前，这片区域被轨道上的战
舰或者悬浮的伺服颅骨进行了全面的扫描，相
关情报被上传至了风暴队长的数据面板中。
每场战斗限一次，在一名部署至高处的己方风暴
飞鹰特工被激活时，在选择让那名特工进入待
机或着陆前，您可以再次移动一枚空降标识。但
是，您不能将空降标识移动至比原先更接近对手
降落区的位置。
cards.text_en:
TEMPESTUS AQUILON
FACTION EQUIPMENT
DROP AUGURY
Prior to the commencement of hostilities, this region
has been subjected to thorough augur scans by orbiting
warships or hovering servo‑skulls, the resultant
intelligence inloaded to the Tempestor’s slate monitron.
Once per battle, when a friendly TEMPESTUS
AQUILON operative that’s set up above is
activated, before expending or landing that
operative, you can move one of your Drop
markers again. However, it cannot be moved
closer to your opponent’s drop zone.

cards.text:
风暴飞鹰
阵营装备
远程监控员
无论是盘旋在高空中的监控机还是使用战术占
卜仪的支援团队，监控官能够为杀戮小队提供
全面的战略指示。
每场战斗限一次，在拼骰决定先手权时，您可以
重掷自己的 D6。
cards.text_en:
TEMPESTUS AQUILON
FACTION EQUIPMENT
REMOTE OVERSEER
Be it a high‑flying observer aircraft or a specialist team
of lexmechanicae employing tactical augur banks,
monitoring officers provide wider strategic insight as the
firefight rages.
Once per battle, after rolling off to decide
initiative, you can re‑roll your dice.
